from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
program = '''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                x, y = q.popleft()
                comp.append((x, y))
                for nx, ny in ((x-1,y),(x+1,y),(x,y-1),(x,y+1)):
                    if 0 <= nx < h and 0 <= ny < w and grid[nx][ny] != bg and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                        seen.add((nx,ny))
                        q.append((nx,ny))
            comps.append(comp)
    template = max(comps, key=len)
    rs = [r for r, c in template]
    cs = [c for r, c in template]
    if len(set(rs)) == 1:
        ordered = sorted(template, key=lambda p: p[1])
    else:
        ordered = sorted(template, key=lambda p: p[0])
    ar, ac = ordered[len(ordered)//2]
    offsets = [(r-ar, c-ac, grid[r][c]) for r,c in ordered]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    template_set = set(template)
    targets = [comp[0] for comp in comps if len(comp) == 1 and comp[0] not in template_set]
    for r, c in targets:
        for dr, dc, color in offsets:
            nr, nc = r+dr, c+dc
            if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w:
                out[nr][nc] = color
    return out
'''
p=base/'programs'/'task-b8840d54.py'
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
exec(compile(program, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
